  -- The angle at B is greater than the angle at C.
  have h3 : (∠ a:b:c : ℝ) > (∠ b:c:a : ℝ) := h2
  -- Use the triangle inequality to compare the sides opposite to the angles.
  have h4 : |(a─c)| > |(a─b)| := by
    -- Use the fact that in a triangle, the side opposite to the greater angle is longer.
    apply Triangle.greaterSide
    -- Use the fact that the angles sum to less than two right angles.
    <;> simp [h1, h2, h3]
  -- Conclude the proof.
  exact h4
